frequency_question: How often do congressional attempts to block submitted 123 nuclear agreements successfully pass a joint resolution of disapproval and override/avoid a veto?
membership_rule: Includes all formal 123 nuclear cooperation agreements transmitted to Congress under the Atomic Energy Act where a joint resolution of disapproval was introduced and voted upon. Excludes agreements that expired without action or where resolutions failed to clear committee/floor votes.
